title: Final Radius Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly calculate the radius R using the gravitational potential energy condition.

title: Final Density Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly calculate the minimum density ρ of the star.

title: Gravitational Potential Understanding
description: Important Criteria - The student should demonstrate understanding of the gravitational potential energy concept and its application to photons.

title: Expansion Dynamics Derivation
description: Important Criteria - The student must derive the relationship R proportional to t^(2/3) correctly from the equations of motion.

title: Integration Steps
description: Optional Criteria - The student should show clear integration steps leading to the final relationship for R.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the gravitational potential energy calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should ensure all necessary factors, such as constants, are included in the calculations.
